meaning: An integer unit in the model's vocabulary; not always one word or one Chinese character.
The scores from the output head; they become probabilities only after the chosen sampling chain.
Maps scores to probabilities that sum to 1; subtracting the maximum first helps numerical stability.
Generates one token at a time, conditioned on the history; an early fork changes every later conditional distribution.
Changes how sharp the sampling distribution is; in practice greedy decoding is usually a separate branch.
One of the inputs to random choice; on its own it does not guarantee bit-identical output across kernels.
Data with axes, a shape, a layout and a number type; more than a bare array.
How many elements or bytes you skip when one coordinate grows by 1; always state the unit.
One matrix transforms one input; it often lacks weight reuse across tokens.
Transforms a batch of inputs and can reuse the weights, but is still limited by shapes and resources.
Approximates numbers with fewer discrete codes; both the savings and the error must be accounted for.
Metadata needed to rebuild quantized values; it is also part of the real storage cost.
The average of squared differences; it measures numerical error but is not the same as task quality.
A 16-bit floating-point format; it splits range and precision differently from BF16.
Another 16-bit float; the same bit width does not make the bytes interchangeable.
2^20 and 2^30 bytes; keep them apart from the decimal MB / GB.
Bounds reachable performance by peak compute and data traffic, giving an ideal lower-bound time.
Floating-point operations done per byte read across a given memory level.
The overall speedup is limited by the part you did not optimize; 2× locally is not 2× overall.
The serial chain in a dependency graph that sets total completion time; busy resources do not mean it got shorter.
Maps a file into the virtual address space; it does not guarantee every page is physically resident.
The page you touched is not ready to use yet; this may trigger a load or other kernel work.
Manages resources through object lifetimes; asynchronous readers still need an explicit completion protocol.
A condition every allowed state of the system must satisfy; easier to check than "it should be fine".
The denominator uses the mean of squares; different from L2Norm, which uses the sum of squares.
A path that keeps and combines earlier representations; this case study has multi-stream gated residuals.
Several query heads share fewer K/V heads; KV storage is counted by the number of K/V heads.
Encodes order through position-dependent rotations; a config change affects whether a cache is compatible.

zh: this case study's sparse attention path
meaning: Includes the indexer, selection and gather; the layer type does not mean each step reads the whole history.
Stores past intermediate K/V to avoid recomputation; keep capacity and residency location separate.
Supplies scores / indices for choosing past positions; its discrete selection boundary needs its own verification.
Lets each row see only the allowed past; prefill cannot look at the future either.
Keeps a recurrent state through decay and rank-one updates; that does not make the whole hybrid model's state fixed-size.
Updates a matrix by the outer product of a column vector and a row vector; used in this book's recurrence derivation.
A router picks a few experts for the current computation; total parameters differ from active parameters.
Picks the k highest-scoring items; the boundary can be sensitive to tiny numerical changes.
An always-used compute path separate from the routed experts; do not leave it out of the traffic budget.

zh: this case study's learned table lookup
meaning: A model component that depends on token history; do not confuse it with prompt-lookup drafting.
A key first maps to a set, then takes one way in that set; set conflicts can happen.
Evicts by recency of access; not the same as the rotation policy of this case study's PLE.
Chooses by access frequency; may lag behind shifts in what is hot.
Identity, mapping and content all satisfy the contract; finding a matching tag alone is not enough.
The subset of data actually accessed often during a phase; not the whole history.
Host pages that meet the stable / registered conditions; not a synonym for already being in VRAM.
A device moves data by agreement; a protocol is needed between submit-returned and completion-visible.
One of the transfer paths between the CPU and devices such as the GPU; do not use VRAM bandwidth in place of its bandwidth.
Carries ordered submissions; different streams need explicit dependencies.
Captures operations and dependencies, then replays them; dynamic arguments may need fixed-address buffers.
Merges operations to cut launches and intermediate reads and writes; it can also raise resource pressure.
Short-lived but easy to share by mistake under concurrency; it needs an owner or mutual exclusion.
Processes the known input sequence and builds state; usually organized differently from decode.
The loop that generates the next tokens from the current state; not the same as decoding characters.
The unit for running a long input in groups; its size affects reuse, capacity and responsiveness.
One of this case study's draft sources; the candidates still need target verification.
Guess and run candidates first, then commit only the prefix that passes the rules.
Advances the accepted history into permanently visible state; changing a counter alone is not enough.
The probability this position is accepted, given that every earlier draft was accepted.
Updates an estimate with recursive weighting; there is a trade-off between reaction speed and noise.
A set of restorable states for a clear history boundary; more than just KV.
Share read-only data first and isolate it before a write; needs reference and lifetime management.
Puts consecutive or chosen layers on different devices; the layer dependency of a single token remains.
Common in vector instructions and GPU thread organization respectively; neither guarantees the same order of arithmetic.
Organizes a response as UTF-8 text with event boundaries; a network read chunk is not an event.
A character can take several bytes; stream processing must hold on to incomplete byte sequences.
A simple queueing policy; long requests can block short ones.
Dynamically combines several sequences for execution; not another name for several HTTP threads.
Atomically accounts for and reserves resources before execution starts, to prevent overcommitment.
An identity that tells old execution from new; helps reject stale results that arrive late.
Gives different implementations the same token history, so free-running divergence does not hide where they differ.
Provides checkable answers or properties; independence matters more than quantity.
Checks invariants through equivalent transformations, e.g. swapping physical pages must not change the logical output.
Time from a defined request start to the first token; usually includes queueing.
Shows the tail, not the average; state the sample size and the percentile method.
Work finished per unit time; do not mix the system total with the per-stream figure.
